summary.description: A concise Markdown overview beginning with a ## Minimalism section.

finding_id.description: Stable defect identity in the form minimalism:stable-subject:short-structure-slug, independent of the current path. Reuse an earlier matching ID for the same issue across prose, path, symbol, or line changes.

path.description: Repository-relative path exactly as it appears in the diff.

line.description: Line in the new file version that appears in a PR diff hunk.

body.description: A self-contained comment naming what to remove, the smaller implementation, and why behavior remains equivalent.
